# Architecture

Status: only the render core is built (see [Render Core](#render-core)). The `web`, `api`,
queue, database, TTS, and stock search are agreed design and not yet built.

## Tech Stack

**Frontend:** Next.js (React, TypeScript). The UI needs a scene editor, image assignment, a job
log, and later a scheduling calendar. A Streamlit UI cannot support these for multiple users.

**Backend:** Python with a FastAPI API and a separate render worker.

**Database:** PostgreSQL for users, videos, scenes, assets, jobs, and the knowledge base.

**Queue:** Redis-backed job queue. Long-running work never runs in the API process: renders,
Claude script generation, and Knowledge Base drafting all run in the worker.

**Rendering:** Python builds an FFmpeg filter graph:

- `zoompan` creates the Ken Burns motion.
- `overlay` places the text, followed by transitions and the audio mix.
- Pillow pre-renders text boxes as transparent PNGs.

**Rationale:**

- **Reference pipeline:** the pipeline stages follow
  [MoneyPrinterTurbo](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo) (MIT).
- **Own repository, not a fork:** MoneyPrinterTurbo carries many unused providers, OAuth flows,
  and a Streamlit UI. It also has no auth, no database, no scene model, and uses stock video clips
  instead of photos.
- **No MoviePy compositing:** MoviePy composites frames in Python and is the speed bottleneck. A
  native FFmpeg filter graph is faster, and porting the backend to Go would add no further speed.
- **No Remotion:** Remotion needs a paid Company License for teams of 4 or more people.

## Components

All components will run under Docker Compose (planned; not set up yet).

| Component | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `web` | Next.js UI. Calls the API only. |
| `api` | FastAPI app. Handles auth, CRUD for videos, scenes, assets, the knowledge base, and the music library. Enqueues jobs. |
| `worker` | Consumes jobs: script generation, Knowledge Base drafting (Claude), and the render pipeline. |
| `postgres` | Relational data. |
| `redis` | Job queue. |
| storage volume | Uploaded photos, stock images, music, TTS audio, rendered MP4s. |

The storage volume could move to S3/R2 later.

**Render pipeline:** for each scene, the worker:

1. Resolves the image: the member's upload, otherwise a stock search using the scene's keywords.
2. Synthesizes TTS when the video has it enabled.
3. Renders the text overlay PNG.
4. Composes everything in a single FFmpeg filter graph with the background music, producing a 9:16
   MP4.

Code adapted from MoneyPrinterTurbo modules (voice, material search) keeps its MIT
attribution.

### Render Core

Steps 3–4 of the render pipeline are built as the Python package `reels_render` in
[worker/](../../../../worker/), with a thin CLI (`python -m reels_render script.json -o out.mp4
[--music …] [--music-volume …]`). The future worker calls the same callable `render_video`,
which raises typed errors (subclasses of `RenderError`) whose Vietnamese messages are meant for
the job log.

- **Script input:** a JSON file with a title scene and content scenes, each with `text`,
  `seconds`, and `image`. Image paths are relative to the JSON file. See
  [samples/xuong-khop.json](../../../../samples/xuong-khop.json).
- **Missing image is an error.** There is no placeholder background; stock search will fill images
  later.
- **The title scene has its own image and length.** It never borrows scene 1's image. The data
  model below has no field for these yet; the spec that connects stored videos to the renderer
  must add one.
- **Validation runs before FFmpeg.** The output is written to a temp file next to the target and
  replaced only after a successful render.
- **FFmpeg safety:** every file is passed with `-i` and referenced by stream label, never written
  into the filter graph. FFmpeg is called with an argument list, not a shell.
- **FFmpeg compatibility:** use only filters and options available since FFmpeg 4.3, because the
  Linux worker image and its FFmpeg version are not chosen yet.
- **Audio bed:** without music the video still gets a silent track, so TTS can later be mixed onto
  it.
- **Font:** Be Vietnam Pro Black (OFL) is bundled in the package, not installed per machine.

## External Integrations

| Service | Use | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Claude API | Script generation; drafting Knowledge Base content | Model is configurable; the default is `claude-sonnet-5-5`. Knowledge drafting uses web search so it can return source URLs. |
| edge-tts | Vietnamese TTS in the MVP | Unofficial Microsoft endpoint that may stop working. Must be swappable by config. |
| Azure Speech | Official TTS fallback | Same neural voices (vi-VN HoaiMy/NamMinh), plus English later. |
| Pexels, Pixabay | Keyword stock image search for scenes without an upload | Free for commercial use. Store source and license info on the asset. |
| FFmpeg | Rendering | Planned to ship in the worker image; on the dev host it is installed natively (see [deployment.md](deployment.md#current-state)). |

Later phases add the Meta (Instagram/Facebook) and TikTok publishing APIs.

## Data Flow

1. A member enters a topic.
2. A worker job calls Claude with the Knowledge Base documents and the approved food bank rows
   (see [content.md](content.md#script-generation-contract)).
3. The member edits the script and assigns photos to scenes.
4. The API enqueues a render job.
5. The worker resolves missing images, generates TTS, renders the MP4 to storage, and updates the
   job record.
6. The job log shows the result.

## Data Model

| Entity | Key contents |
|---|---|
| User | email, password hash |
| Video | topic, title options, chosen title, caption, hashtags, affiliate suggestions + pinned comment, self-review notes, content language (`vi` now, `en` later), TTS on/off, music track |
| Scene | belongs to Video; order, seconds, on-screen text with `*red*` keyword markup, image prompt/keywords, assigned Asset |
| Asset | uploaded photo, stock image, or music track; source and license info |
| RenderJob | belongs to Video; status, timings, output file, error, re-run of a previous job |
| KnowledgeDoc | one per knowledge document type; editable content (no approval state) |
| FoodItem | food, main nutrients, benefits, who should avoid it, source URLs, `draft` / `approved` status |

The migration tool will be chosen at scaffold time.

### Sensitive Data

- API keys (Anthropic, Pexels, Pixabay, Azure) live only in environment variables. They are never
  committed or stored in the database.
- Passwords are stored hashed.
- The only personal data is team members' emails.
